BERLIN, Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Acer today announced two new mainstream computing solutions for gamers, creators, and beyond. The lineup was announced at the next@Acer global press conference during IFA 2026.
Aspire G 3D 16 Laptop: Immersive 3D Experiences for Creating, Gaming, and Productivity

The 16-inch Aspire G 3D 16 (AG3D16-81M) laptop brings immersive 3D experiences to a range of use cases, from design and creative work to gaming and entertainment, while bypassing the need for native 3D content and a discrete GPU. Running on Windows 11, it is powered by the AMD Ryzen™ AI Max+ 395 processor with up to 126 overall TOPS and AMD Radeon™ 8060S graphics. The system supports up to 128 GB of LPDDR5X-8000 memory and up to 2 TB of M.2 SSD storage[2].

At the core of the laptop's 3D capability is its naked-eye 3D technology. Dual eye-tracking cameras allow the system to render standard 2D content in 3D[3], transforming everyday photos, videos, and other 2D material into immersive 3D visuals that bring ideas, models, games, and entertainment to life. The laptop also comes with the SpatialLabs™ 3D Hub app preloaded, enabling 3D viewing, 2D-to-3D conversion, and immersive entertainment. In supported games, 3D depth also helps scenes feel more dimensional, adding clearer separation between foreground, background, environments, and on-screen effects.

The Aspire G 3D 16 features a 16-inch 3D IPS display with WQXGA+ resolution of 3840 x 2400 (1920 x 2400 in 3D mode), a 16:10 aspect ratio, 100% DCI-P3 color coverage, and a 120 Hz refresh rate. The laptop offers a large-capacity 99.9 Wh battery.

Additional features include an optional fingerprint sensor on the power button, a precision touchpad, and a RGB-backlit keyboard with red WASD keys. Top connectivity features include Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.4, and dual USB 4.0 Type-C ports. The Aspire G 3D 16 comes in a metal chassis in meteorite gray.
Aspire S 27 and Aspire S 24 AIOs: Minimalist Family Computer Powered by Intel Core Series 3

The 27-inch Aspire S 27 (S27B-WCLLP) and 23.8-inch Aspire S 24 (S24B-WCLLP) all-in-one desktops are refreshed from the previous generation. Now powered by up to an Intel Core 7 processor 350, they deliver responsive performance for work, learning, entertainment, and seamless multitasking. Running on Windows 11, this generation also offers the upgrade of a touchscreen option that includes support for a stylus pen. Both models continue the minimalist white profile of their predecessors and serve as a stylish home computer for the family.

The Aspire S 27 is available with either a QHD (2560 x 1440) panel with a 120 Hz refresh rate or an FHD (1920 x 1080) panel with a 144 Hz refresh rate. The Aspire S 24 offers the FHD, 144 Hz option only. Both models have a 90% screen-to-body ratio with narrow bezels.

The Aspire S series AIOs extend configurations with up to 16 GB of LPDDR5 memory and up to 1 TB of M.2 SSD storage[2]. Additional features include an FHD webcam with a privacy shutter, Intel Wi-Fi 6E, and Bluetooth 5.3. Connectivity comprises one USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C port for data transfer only and one HDMI port.
